text:
maria: apiserver proxy handoff delays in eu-west1 are spiking — GPU attach backlog ~30m, controller-manager reconcile lag and a bunch of 429/503s. anyone oncall?

kyle: i'm oncall, looking. initial hint: proxy conn reuse seems exhausted on the NAT path. samples from logs: 
```
E 09:12:34 apiserver proxy error: dial tcp 10.4.2.11:443: connect: connection timed out
I 09:12:35 controller-manager reconcile: 12.3s (pods stuck attaching)
```

maria: keepalive RTTs also spiked at the same time, SYN retries visible to provisioner nodes. :thinking:

dmitri: can you paste netstat/ipvs from an affected host? what's pending GPU count?

kyle: pending GPUs: 18 in eu-west1-gpu-pool-a, attach queue length ~42. `kubectl get pods -n provisioner -o wide` shows many AttachVolume/AttachDevice in Pending.

neha: we had a NAT ephemeral port pressure earlier; cloud raised SNAT but proxy sidecars hold long-lived conns, so reuse pattern causes port churn -> exhaustion on busy nodes.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20261234 — apiserver-proxy-handoff-eu-west1. Pager notified.

maria: quick mitigation idea: reduce apiserver proxy keepalive and force connection TTL/rotate to break stuck sockets. kyle, can you roll one apiserver with a short-lived config?

kyle: rolling apiserver now via deploy-tool. also bumping provisioner replicas +2 to absorb queue while we stabilize. running: `deploy-tool restart apiserver --zone eu-west1`

dmitri: add routing fallback to reserved GPU pool for critical tenants to avoid 503 cascades. also suggest enabling prefix KV cache for watch-heavy controllers to drop apiserver read QPS.

maria: FYI cost / runway check — +2 provisioner replicas ~0.6 vGPU-hr/minute. tagging finance: @lee for temporary approval.

lee: noted. please add a short PR with expected spend delta and TTL for the scale, we can greenlight emergency minutes.

kyle: apiserver restart completed. observed connection reuse drop from 95% to 12% and attach queue dropped to ~21. still seeing occasional controller-manager reconcile spikes (2-6s).

neha: long-term: move proxy to explicit connection pooling with per-tenant slotting + backpressure and better ephemeral port hygiene. drafting RFC and perf tests.

maria: good. saving logs and config diffs to /var/logs/incident/6124578910.log and will start a short postmortem doc. anyone with telemetry graphs, drop links here.

kyle: uploading CPU/conn graphs to the incident ticket. next steps: PR to reduce default keepalive to 30s, provisioner autoscale tweak, and a routing fallback policy.

maria: thanks all — marking as incident-in-progress. will follow up with timeline and action items in the PM doc. :white_check_mark:
